native_cache_contract.source: fixed native CLI and isolated read-only cache evidence, not a cloud endpoint

fields.vehicles[].business_line: native CLI ebike/motor routing source; not businessType inference

native_cache_contract.ha_representation: internal transport cache only; no entity or diagnostic values

auth_and_controls.auth: login/SMS/refresh/whoami retained as session/account operations, not vehicle state entities; do not publish tokens/phone/account. SMS is not a readonly research operation.
auth_and_controls.control: bell/buck/engine-start/engine-stop are Buttons; upstream null permissions is not approval; routes verified offline, no physical outcome proof.
auth_and_controls.serve_and_mcp: service interfaces, not telemetry fields. Production uses authenticated loopback REST with CLI vehicle-cache preparation.

safety.unknown_fields: retain only in bounded private raw; counts can be summarized, arbitrary key names or values never exported to entity state.
